main_text.p: & ad supradictum Nolanum duas, et ad alios alias. Sed quia in aliquibus etiam fami-liaris necessitas inserta est, non digeruntur. Composuit & Chronica. Scripsit & ad multorum profectum vitam B. Martini monachi & episcopi signis & prodigiis & virtutibus illustris viri, & Collationem Posthumiani & Galli, se mediante & judice, de conver-satione monachorum Orientalium & ipsius Martini, habitam in specie dialogi, duabus incisionibus comprehendit: in quarum priore refert suo tempore apud Alexandrinam synodum episcoporum decretum, Originem & cautius a sapientibus pro bono legendum, & a minus capacibus pro malo repudiandum. Hic in senectute sua a Pelagianis deceptus, & agnoscens loquacitatis culpam, silentium usque ad mortem tenuit, ut peccatum, quod loquendo contraxerat, tacendo penitus emē-daret.
main_text.head: Guibertus abbas Gemblacensis.
main_text.p: Quod autem a Pelagianis seductus in aliquo a regula orthodoxa fidei exorbitaverit, nusquam omnino, nisi in solo Gennadio legi,

page.notes: The first word of the page continues the previous paragraph, so it is marked cont="true". The heading is an author's name introducing a section, set apart and centred, so it is level 2. Uncertain readings: "orthodoxa" (the final letter may be æ) and "emē-" (the macron over e is read as an abbreviation for n). Printed long s and the s-like f forms were transcribed as s. No page number or running head is printed.
